sara: Quick postmortem follow-up from the on-call rotation. We saw a cross-region LB/DNS retry spike overnight that correlated with TLS handshake failures and a routing flap. I want owners, timelines, and a short rollback plan documented here. TL;DR: reduce retry amplification, patch route selection, add probes + alert tuning.

alex: Assigning owners: @mike -> routing patch + canary; @priya -> LB/TLS audit and cert probes; @sophia -> post-deploy validation + smoke tests. I'll own alert tuning and tracking.

mike: Taking routing. I'll open a PR to tighten route selection and avoid sticky re-eval oscillation. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Will include a small unit test and canary flag.

priya: Taking LB/TLS. I'll audit SNI mapping and cert rotation probes, add more verbose TLS traces for the 03:00 UTC window, and add a synthetic EU->US probe. ETA: 48h.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2498 linked to postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-2498

alex: Action summary (adding due dates):
  1) Routing PR (@mike) - 24h checkpoint, deploy canary within 48h
  2) LB/TLS fixes (@priya) - 48h to PR, 72h to canary
  3) Smoke tests & validation (@sophia) - 72h to baseline tests
  4) Alert/monitor tuning (@alex) - 1 week follow-up
Please add rollback steps to your PRs and link tickets.

mike: Found recurring pattern in egress logs around 03:00 UTC: route flap + conn reset. Adding a metric to surface per-peer flap counts. Suspect peering churn + aggressive route re-eval.

priya: Sample log snippet I'm seeing in the TLS traces (will add to the diagnostic doc):
```
[LB] 2026-03-20T03:12:17Z TLS handshake failed: remote_reset
peer=eu-west-1 route=arn:lb:eu-west-1:pool/35
retries=3
```
This suggests remote side reset + repeated client retries amplified downstream. I'm going to lower the client-side cross-region retry window from 5->3 for now to reduce amplification.

alex: Good catch. Lowering client retries is a quick mitigation; ensure we coordinate deploy windows to avoid cascading changes during the daily 03:00 churn. Also add a short-term alert: retry-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m.

sophia: I'll own validation & rollback doc. Rollback plan: revert canary flag, drain affected nodes, failover traffic back to regional pools. I'll add a clear playbook to the runbook with checklist.

sara: Please make sure we have checkpoints: 24h status update, 72h verification of canary, 7-day recurrence review to check for pattern reappearance. I'll schedule calendar slots and post them here.

priya: Opening PRs now and will link them here. Diagnostic dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/incidents/2498 (contains the TLS trace panel + per-peer flap graph).

mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5247 - initial route-selection change. Reviewers: @alex, @sophia. Includes unit + integration test.

alex: Looks good. Add a note in PR about expected canary metrics and rollback triggers.

priya: PR for LB changes: https://github.com/redwood/loadbalancer/pull/1982 - adds SNI validation checks and synthetic probe config.

alex: Final ask: everyone react with :thumbsup: when you confirm your ownership & ETA, and drop blockers here if any. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for postmortem action progress.

sara: Thanks team — I'll follow up in 24h with the status rollup. :wave:
